name: obsidian-sidecalc
description: Scientific math calculator in your sidebar: fractions, roots, trig, logs, integrals, derivatives, sums, an equation solver with graphs, history, variables and LaTeX insert into notes.

scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build && mkdir -p "$VAULT/.obsidian/plugins/sidecalc" && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "$VAULT/.obsidian/plugins/sidecalc/"
